wedo_instance.description: Establish a remote AWS substrate for MetaGit Feed mirroring and remote technical strikes (al.isle.ventures).

meta.philosophy: The AWS Node is an on-demand mirror, not a replacement. It provides global visibility while keeping legislative sovereignty local.

rules.sovereignty: The AWS machine is a field copy. The local filesystem remains the Root of Trust.
rules.on_demand: Compute resources must be halted when not metabolizing strikes to optimize cost.
rules.sync_integrity: Always verify checksums after rsync to ensure DNA parity.

tasks.description: Local Tooling: Install AWS CLI and Terraform on local machine.
Identity Provisioning: Create bestape-admin IAM user and configure 'aws configure'.
Key Generation: Create 'eustathius-key' PEM and set chmod 400.
Substrate Provisioning: Run 'terraform apply' in repos/island_ventures/aws/.
Domain Handshake: Point Namecheap nameservers to Cloudflare and create 'al' A record.
DNA Mirroring: Run './aws_strike.sh sync' to initialize remote substrate.
Remote Boot: SSH into AWS and start the Metagit Feed (npm run dev).
